title: 第17章 大道先争何为仙第18章 命运多舛余岁安
content_zh:
;;
七峰长老纷纷点头应和，毕竟李南廷的实力他们都是知道的。
如此天赋，李南廷重新出山收他为关门弟子，众人也都能理解了。
毕竟，谁也不想白来人世走一遭，总会想把一身本领传下去。
众人散去。
李南廷带着李观棋回到了自己的别院之中。
非常朴素的进行了一个拜师礼。
跪拜，敬茶，礼成。
李南廷轻声道：“观棋，今日你我成为师徒，便是缘分。”
“为师也没什么可以送你的，就送你一枚丹药吧。”
刷！
老者左手戒指灵光一闪，手中出现了一方玉匣。
李观棋小心翼翼的接过玉匣，打开后发现里面有一枚圆润光滑的丹药。
但是这丹药却有着荧光闪烁。
“师傅，这是……”
老者微微一笑，轻声道：“上品筑基丹。”
李观棋微微一愣，连忙将玉匣小心合上退给老者。
“不行不行，师父，这东西太珍贵了。”
“您还是留着吧。”
老者哈哈一笑，轻声道：“给你你就拿着吧，老夫也就这点值钱东西了。”

“原本宗主也想赐你筑基丹的，但是这种东西太过显眼，怕给你惹来麻烦。”
“索性就想等着你练气十层的时候再给你，但是老夫不同。”
“既然我有，那就给你！”
可李观棋依旧坚持道：“师傅，这东西放我身上我连觉都睡不好。”
“这样，先放在您这，等我需要的时候再给我。”
见少年坚持不要，老者也没多说，反手将玉匣收起。
轻声道：“既然如此，那为师就先帮你收着。”
“嗯…我看你气血磅礴，锻体的底子非常扎实！”
“是有家里长辈教导过你？”
李观棋挠了挠头回想起爷爷那副严厉的模样。
恭敬的回道：“我爷爷从小就给我泡药浴什么的，每天让我负重上下山，还要打拳桩。”
“不知不觉就这样了。”

The elders of Qifeng nodded in agreement. After all, they all knew Li Nanting's strength.
With such talent, everyone could understand that Li Nanting came out again and accepted him as his disciple.
After all, no one wants to live in this world in vain, and they always want to pass on their skills.
Everyone dispersed.
Li Nanting took Li Guanqi back to his villa.
A very simple apprenticeship ceremony was performed.
Kneel down, offer tea, and the ceremony is complete.
Li Nanting said softly: "Guan Qi, it is fate that you and I become master and apprentice today."
"I don't have anything to give you as a teacher, so I'll just give you a pill."
Brush!
The ring in the old man's left hand flashed with inspiration, and a jade box appeared in his hand.
Li Guanqi carefully took the jade box and opened it and found a round and smooth pill inside.
But this elixir has fluorescent light.
"Master, this is..."
The old man smiled slightly and said softly: "High-quality foundation-building pill."
Li Guanqi was slightly startled, then carefully closed the jade box and returned it to the old man.
"No, no, Master, this thing is too precious."
"You'd better keep it."
The old man laughed and said softly: "Just take it, I only have this little valuable thing."
"Originally, the sect master also wanted to give you the Foundation Building Pill, but this kind of thing is too conspicuous and I'm afraid it will cause you trouble."
"I just wanted to wait until you reach the tenth level of Qi training before giving it to you, but I'm different."
"Since I have it, I'll give it to you!"
But Li Guanqi still insisted: "Master, I can't even sleep well if you put this thing on me."
"In this way, I will leave it with you first and give it to me when I need it."
Seeing that the young man insisted not to take it, the old man didn't say much and put away the jade box with his backhand.
He said softly: "In that case, I will help you keep it first."
"Well... I see that you are full of energy and have a very solid foundation in physical training!"
"Did any elders in your family teach you?"
Li Guanqi scratched his head and recalled his grandfather's stern look.
He replied respectfully: "My grandfather has given me medicinal baths and other things since I was a child. He makes me carry weights up and down the mountain every day, and he also has to hit a boxing pile."
“It happened before I knew it.”
